Markets.title: Banking liquidity surplus shrinks to Rs 541 crore as cash crunch increases
Markets.summary: India's banking liquidity surplus dropped sharply to ₹541 crore by October 21 as banks parked more funds to meet cash reserve requirements. Consequently, the weighted average call rate rose 15 basis points above the repo rate to 5.65%, prompting the Reserve Bank of India to conduct variable rate repo operations.

Markets.title: Global Market Today: Asian stocks slide after US tech rout
Markets.summary: Asian stocks fell for the second consecutive day following a technology rout in the United States. Meanwhile, Taiwan's stock exchange announced it would be closed on Friday due to an approaching typhoon.

Markets.title: Sun Pharma falls short of bond fundraising target amid rising yields
Markets.summary: Sun Pharma raised ₹7,816 crore through five- and seven-year bonds, missing its ₹10,000-crore target due to investor caution from rising market yields. The pharmaceutical company priced the bonds at 8.05% and 8.20%, which included ₹2,100 crore secured through anchor investments.

Markets.title: Rupee declines first time in eight sessions as Brent oil prices rise above $112
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee dropped for the first time in eight sessions on Thursday as Brent oil prices rose above $112 per barrel. Currency traders expect the rupee to trade between 94.50 and 95.25 on Friday, with potential intervention from the Reserve Bank of India.

Markets.title: Government plans to pare stakes in 4 PSU banks to 75%
Markets.summary: The Indian government plans to reduce its ownership in four public sector banks to 75%. This move aligns with the 2021-22 budget announcement to privatize select state-run financial institutions.

Markets.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
Markets.summary: Indian stock indices fell for the third consecutive session amid weak global cues and a falling rupee. The market may recover if the index reclaims 22,800, with immediate support resting at 22,600.

Geo-Political.summary: A BBC investigation found that Sudan's RSF fighters deliberately targeted hospitals. The UN human rights chief stated that these multiple attacks may amount to war crimes.

Geo-Political.summary: Newborn twins Raghed and Raad are fighting for survival amidst a severe hunger crisis in Yemen. Their family was forced to flee their home on foot due to ongoing fighting between pro-government forces and the Houthis.

Geo-Political.title: L'Oreal says weight loss drugs are impacting beauty and skin care sales

Geo-Political.summary: Donald Trump is suing the BBC regarding a 2021 Panorama episode that edited together two separate parts of his speech. A court has now ordered him to answer questions under oath as part of the lawsuit.

Data & Insights.title: India's Mideast oil imports return to pre-war levels in September
Data & Insights.summary: India's oil imports from the Middle East returned to pre-war levels in September. This recovery occurred as refiners purchased spot cargoes while producers and traders increased shipments through the Strait of Hormuz to ease supply constraints caused by the Iran war.

Data & Insights.title: The story of India’s post-election defection wave since 2022, in charts
Data & Insights.summary: Between 2022 and 2026, over 100 Indian lawmakers switched political parties by exploiting loopholes in the anti-defection law. The National Democratic Alliance (NDA) emerged as the primary beneficiary of this defection wave.

Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated that future interest rate hikes will depend on the evolving growth and inflation outlook. Policymakers hold differing views on how to balance controlling inflation without unnecessarily restricting economic activity.

Data & Insights.title: RBI MPC minutes reveal 2 members opposed shift from neutral stance to calibrated tightening in October meeting
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India raised its repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50% with unanimous support from all six monetary policy committee members. However, two members dissented from the majority by opposing a shift from a neutral stance to calibrated tightening during the October meeting.

Data & Insights.title: Core sector growth accelerates to 7.9% in September, fastest in new series
Data & Insights.summary: India's core sector growth accelerated to 7.9% in September, driven by double-digit increases in iron ore, electricity, coal, refinery products, and cement. Meanwhile, fertilizers, natural gas, and crude oil experienced production contractions during the same month.

Data & Insights.title: India's infrastructure output grows 7.9% year-on-year in September on strong coal, steel output
Data & Insights.summary: India's infrastructure output grew by 7.9% year-on-year in September, accelerating from the 3.1% growth recorded in the same month last year. This increase was primarily driven by higher production of coal, refinery products, steel, and iron ore.
